title: Weighted Lebesgue points of the orientation of a rectifiable triple (Steps 1–3)
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let (M, θ, ξ) satisfy IsRectifiableTriple ℝ^P n M θ ξ (with U = ℝ^P), and write Hⁿ = μHE[n]. Then for Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. x, the quotient (∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal(θ(y))‖ξ(y) − ξ(x)‖ₑ dHⁿ(y)) / (∫⁻_{M∩B̄_s(x)} ofReal(θ(y)) dHⁿ(y)) tends to 0 in [0, ∞] as s → 0⁺. The division is ENNReal division: a/0 = ∞ for a ≠ 0 and 0/0 = 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n M θ ξ → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) * ‖ξ y - ξ x‖ₑ ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) / (∫⁻ y in M ∩ closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (θ y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
